queries:
WITH f AS (
    SELECT account_id, type, amount, balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount > 2400
),
per_account AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
                 WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
            END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM f
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS mean_avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) AS mean_avg_balance
FROM per_account;
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans
